newsitem.title: USA: First USA Q3 managed delinquency rate fell.
newsitem.headline: First USA Q3 managed delinquency rate fell.

text.p: First USA Inc on Thursday said its managed delinquency rate in the third quarter ending March 31 fell to 4.96 percent from 5.19 percent in the previous quarter ending December 31, 1996.
Earlier, First USA, a provider of Visa and MasterCard services, reported third quarter net earnings per share at $0.17 compared with restated year-ago earnings of $0.63.
The firm also said its marketing programs generated 877,000 new accounts during the quarter, increasing the company's total customer base to 16.3 million cardmembers."

In connection with the pending merger with Banc One Corp, First USA has restated its financial statements with respect to two accounting policies to more appropriately reflect gains on securitizations and marketing expense.

The restatement increased income in fiscal year 1994 before extraordinary item to $150.9 million, or $1.23 per share, compared with $103.5 million, or $0.84 per share, previously reported, and resulted in revisions of previously reported quarterly results in fiscal years 1995 and 1996.
The adjustments should not have any adverse effect on First USA's operations or growth plans for 1997 or 1998, the company said.
